dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible thick white horizontal band with high grayscale contrast against the blue-gray covert feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale linear boundaries along the edges of the dark folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, high-contrast yellowish-white rectangular patch is visible on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear boundary separating the black crown from the olive-green mantle, although partially interrupted by the nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent, high-contrast white cheek patch defined by a sharp black border extending from the chin to the nape.
